title: Thailand Cave Rescue
description: In June 2018, 13 people were trapped in a flooded cave in Thailand. MSgt Derek Anderson was among those called for the rescue. This is his story.
keywords: Aviano AB, United States Air Force, USAF, AFN Aviano, 31FW, AIr Force, Aviano Air Base, Italy, 31st Fighter Wing

transcript.text: - [Narrator] In June 2018, twelve Thai children,
and their soccer coach, found themselves trapped
deep in a cave, with no way out.
Master Sergeant Derek Anderson, the Superintendent
of Special Tactics and Weapons programs here at Aviano,
was part of this rescue operation,
and this is his experience.
- [Derek] Initially, it was raining really hard at the cave.
We just came in and we met with some of the Thai Navy SEALS
that were already there for a few days.
I think the most difficult part is there was no rule book.
No one had ever done a rescue like this before so,
we still only thought, maybe we had a 50% chance of success.
But, what we did know is if we didn't do anything,
if we waited the five or six months for the rains to stop
and then the water to come down,
they would have for sure all died.
- [Narrator] Master Sergeant Anderson learned a lot from
the Thailand cave rescue, which is why he talked
to Aviano Airbase, about the lessons he learned
in cross cultural communication, leadership,
and working in a complex, multinational environment.
Airman First Class, Kevin Allen, Aviano Airbase, Italy.
